parameters.content:
## How it Works
This workflow automates issuing  workshop certificates. When a participant submits the registration form via google sheet, their data is validated and their email is checked using VerifiEmail. If valid, the workflow generates a unique certificate ID, builds a verification URL and QR code, converts the certificate HTML into an image, saves it to Google Drive, emails it to the attendee, logs the registration in Google Sheets, and sends a Slack notification to the organizers. A JSON confirmation is also returned to the webhook.

## Setup Steps
1. Add required credentials: VerifiEmail, HTMLCSStoImage, Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack.  
2. Replace placeholder URLs or Drive folders with your own.  
3. Update certificate HTML template with your branding (optional).  
4. Publish the workflow and connect your form to the webhook URL.  
5. Test using a real email address.

## Validation
Google sheet receives form data.  
Node checks if name, email, and event are present.  
If missing → return validation error.  
Email is then verified using VerifiEmail.

## Certificate Generation
Generates unique Certificate ID + QR code, inserts attendee/event details into the HTML template, and converts it into PNG using HTMLCSStoImage.

## Storage
Certificate PNG is downloaded and uploaded to Google Drive.  
Metadata (event, certificate ID, attendee) is saved for easy lookup.

## Email Delivery
Sends participant an HTML email including event info, QR code, and the certificate image/download link.

## Logging & Alerts
Registration + certificate details are logged in Google Sheets.  
Slack message notifies organizers of new registration.

## Response
Returns JSON with success message, certificateId, and verification URL.
